_why_md013_is_off: MD013 (line-length) is disabled because a GitHub-flavored markdown table row must be
one physical line -- it cannot be wrapped at all. The tuning-knob table in README.md
has rows up to ~700 characters, and pymarkdown's MD013 has no table exemption (unlike
markdownlint's `tables: false`), so the rule can only be all-or-nothing here.
Prose width is enforced separately: every non-table line in README.md is <= 90
columns, which is the same limit ruff and black apply to the Python.
